|desc=Many centuries ago, {{p|Regigigas}} helped protect [[Snowpoint City]] from a volcanic eruption, and slept inside [[Snowpoint Temple]]. There it rested until [[J|Pokémon Hunter J]] destroyed the pillars sealing it, attempting to capture it for a client. Regigigas awakened and went on a rampage threatening Snowpoint City, and after battling Regirock, Registeel, and Regice, was able to bring all three under its control.

All seemed lost until J tried to capture Regigigas again, and Brandon and his legendary giants all risked their lives to protect it, getting petrified by J's bracelet in the process. After J left due to her client canceling the deal, Regigigas restored the ones who protected it to life and then went back to sleep, with Brandon promising to help rebuild the temple and help protect it from further harm.

Regigigas's known moves are {{m|Hyper Beam}}, {{m|Hammer Arm}}{{tt|*|Regigigas could not legally learn Hammer Arm at the time.}}, {{m|Confuse Ray}}, and {{m|Hidden Power}}.}}
